entries.label: How it works title
entries.default: Three steps from post to payout

entries.label: How it works steps
entries.default:
Pick a campaign | Browse campaigns from companies that match your audience. Each one comes with approved content and clear rules.
Share and submit proof | Post the content from your established account, then submit the post link and a screenshot.
Get paid for approved posts | A reviewer checks every post. Approved earnings are paid out on a predictable biweekly schedule.

entries.label: Rules title
entries.default: Fair for you, honest with your audience

entries.label: Rules introduction
entries.default: The rules protect your reputation and the companies you work with. They are the same for everyone.

entries.label: Rules
entries.default:
Established accounts only | Real accounts with a genuine history and audience. We verify every connected account — no bots, no bought followers.
Disclosure is required | Every paid post is clearly labelled (for example #ad or the platform’s paid-partnership tag). Your audience always knows.
Human review | People, not just algorithms, review each submission. If something needs fixing you get specific feedback and a chance to correct it.
Transparent biweekly payouts | See exactly what is pending, approved and scheduled. Payouts run every two weeks with a full history of every amount.

entries.label: Questions introduction
entries.default: Quick answers to what people ask most.

entries.label: Questions and answers
entries.default:
Who can join? | Anyone with an established, genuine social account in a supported country. New or inactive accounts may not qualify for every campaign.
How much can I earn? | Each campaign shows its reward per approved post up front, so you know what you’ll earn before you share.
When do I get paid? | Approved earnings are included in the next biweekly payout once you reach the minimum payout amount.
